title: Project use of == and equals
answer: AeroTopo should use equals() when comparing logical domain values or textual identifiers and reserve == for primitives, enum identity, or deliberate same-object checks. Explain the operator choice from intent: identity comparison differs from value comparison, and the wrong one can silently produce incorrect business logic.
